candidates.name: Battle Resupply
candidates.description: Give an allied Operator within range 1 SP every 3.5s but cause them to lose 0.4% HP/sec, unlimited duration

levels.name: Efficient Resupply
levels.description: While Stainless's Skill is active, the SP recovery effect of this unit's Talent is changed to instead grant <@ba.vup>1</> SP every <@ba.vup>{s2.interval}</> seconds, but doubling the HP loss effect
